newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp, First Union sell funds.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp, First Union sell funds.

text.p: Bank holding companies First Union Corp and KeyCorp said on Thursday their brokerage units would sell each other's mutual fund products through their respective branch networks.
The companies said they believed this was the first cross-sales agreement between two bank mutual fund units.
The combined office networks spans 26 states, they said.
The agreement would significantly increase the number of markets in which Key-managed Victory Funds and First Union-managed Evergreen Keystone Fund families were available, the companies said.

First Union is the third largest bank mutual fund manager with $30 billion in assets under management, and KeyCorp is the 15th largest bank mutual fund manager with $8 billion in assets under management, the companies said.
